applicationProcess.process_md: > **Samagra ID Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the official website: [samagra.gov.in](https://samagra.gov.in/). **Step 2:** Click on the option “Register Family” or “Register Member”. **Step 3:** Enter the Aadhaar number and other required information. **Step 4:** Enter the OTP received on the registered mobile number. **Step 5:** Carefully fill in all the required details and upload the necessary documents. **Step 6:** Enter the captcha code and click on “Submit Application.” > **Offline Samagra ID Registration Process:** **Step 1:** Visit the nearest Lok Seva Kendra, MP Online Kiosk, or Common Service Center (CSC). **Step 2:** Provide the required documents and necessary information to complete the registration process. > **After Samagra Registration:** **Step 1:** The interested applicant downloads the [application form](https://transport.mp.gov.in/sites/default/files/documents/yojna_20150001.pdf) (Page No. 10) from the official website. **Step 2:** In the application form, fill in all the mandatory fields, and attach copies of all the mandatory documents (self-attest, if required). **Step 3:** Submit the duly filled and signed application form along with the documents to the District or Regional Transport Office.

basicDetails.schemeName: Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Sarathi Shri Award

children.text: The applicant should be a permanent resident of Madhya Pradesh.
The applicant should be a registered transport vehicle driver or conductor.
The applicant should possess a valid commercial driving license or conductor's license issued in Madhya Pradesh.
The applicant’s name should be registered on the Samagra Portal.
The applicant should be actively engaged or registered as a transport driver or conductor.
The applicant should not be a government employee.

schemeContent.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide one of the state's best driver "Sarathi Shri" award, which includes a cash prize, a certificate of appreciation, and a trophy.

children.text: The "Motor Vehicle Driver-Conductor Welfare Scheme- Sarathi Shri Award" has been launched by the Transport Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh. Under this scheme, one of the state's best drivers will be honored with the "Sarathi Shri" award, which includes a cash prize, a certificate of appreciation, and a trophy. The state government will present this award at a special ceremony.
